scriptName: Minervini VCP mit Breakout, Exit & EMA-Filter
source:
//@version=5
indicator("Minervini VCP mit Breakout, Exit & EMA-Filter", overlay=true)

vcpPeriod = input.int(50, "VCP-Periode")
pivotLookback = input.int(20, "Pivot-Widerstand (Lookback)")
volFactor = input.float(1.1, "Volatilitaets-Toleranz", step=0.1)
volStopPeriode = input.int(5, "Volumenvergleich (Exit)")
rangeStopPeriode = input.int(5, "TrueRange-Vergleich (Exit)")
vcpNachlauf = input.int(5, "Max Tage nach VCP erlaubt")
emaPeriode = input.int(50, "EMA-Filterperiode")

// === ATR / TR / VOLUME
atr = ta.atr(14)
tr = high - low
avgTR = ta.sma(tr, rangeStopPeriode)
avgVol = ta.sma(volume, volStopPeriode)

// === EMA-FILTER
ema = ta.ema(close, emaPeriode)
preisUeberEMA = close > ema

// === VCP-BEDINGUNG
lowVol = ta.lowest(atr, vcpPeriod)
volContraction = atr <= lowVol * volFactor
vcpKriterium = volContraction and preisUeberEMA
plotshape(vcpKriterium, title="VCP-Potential (mit EMA)", location=location.belowbar, color=color.yellow, style=shape.circle, size=size.tiny)

// === VCP-TIMER
var int vcpCountdown = 0
if vcpKriterium
    vcpCountdown := vcpNachlauf
else
    vcpCountdown := math.max(vcpCountdown - 1, 0)

vcpAktiv = vcpCountdown > 0

// === PIVOT-ZONE FIXIEREN
var float pivotHigh = na
if vcpKriterium or (na(pivotHigh) and vcpAktiv)
    pivotHigh := ta.highest(high, pivotLookback)

plot(pivotHigh, title="Pivot-Level", color=color.red, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_line)

// === BREAKOUT
var bool inBreakout = false
breakoutNow = vcpAktiv and not inBreakout and close > pivotHigh and preisUeberEMA
exitCondition = inBreakout and (volume < avgVol) and (tr < avgTR)

if breakoutNow
    inBreakout := true
else if exitCondition
    inBreakout := false

plotshape(inBreakout ? 1 : na, title="Breakout-Aktiv (mit EMA)", location=location.belowbar, color=color.green, style=shape.circle, size=size.small)
